content.text:
Common use cases for fine-tuning instead of prompting include:
- **Domain-specific knowledge**: When your task requires specialized knowledge or terminology that the base model lacks.
- **Consistent style or tone**: When you need the model to consistently adhere to a specific style, tone, or format.
- **Improving performance on specific tasks**: When prompting alone doesn't achieve the desired accuracy or quality for a niche or custom task.
- **Learning from examples**: When you have high-quality labeled data that can help the model learn patterns or behaviors not easily captured through prompts.

[When to fine-tune](https://docs.mistral.ai/finetuning/introduction#when-to-fine-tune)
